  verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Doctor Strange: Mystical Arts Meet Card Collecting

Doctor Strange (2016) brought magic and the multiverse to the MCU, and Benedict Cumberbatch''s star power made these cards instantly collectible. As the character became increasingly central to the MCU (Infinity War, Endgame, Multiverse of Madness), early Doctor Strange cards have appreciated significantly.

### Key Sets

The **2016 Upper Deck Doctor Strange** set features autographs from the film''s prestigious cast. Benedict Cumberbatch, Mads Mikkelsen, and Tilda Swinton autograph cards are the highlights.

### Market Trends

Benedict Cumberbatch autograph cards have steadily increased as Doctor Strange became one of the MCU''s most important characters. Mads Mikkelsen cards carry a premium due to his cult following. The Time Stone insert cards have gained value as Infinity Stone collecting became popular.',
  keyCards = '- **Benedict Cumberbatch as Doctor Strange Autograph** — MCU debut card ($3,500+)
- **Mads Mikkelsen as Kaecilius Auto** — Cult favorite actor ($600+)
- **Tilda Swinton as The Ancient One Auto** — Prestigious casting ($500+)
- **Benedict Wong as Wong Autograph** — Fan-favorite character ($400+)
- **Time Stone / Eye of Agamotto Insert Cards** — Infinity Stone themed
- **2016 Upper Deck Doctor Strange Sketch Cards** — Original 1/1 mystical artwork',
  content = '## The MCU Gets Magical

Doctor Strange was the MCU''s boldest visual experiment — a mind-bending journey into mysticism, alternate dimensions, and reality-warping magic. Scott Derrickson drew inspiration from Steve Ditko''s psychedelic comic art to create some of the most visually stunning sequences in superhero cinema. The Inception-like city-folding scenes were groundbreaking.

## The Legacy

- **Introduced Magic to the MCU** — Expanded the universe beyond science and technology
- **The Time Stone** — The Eye of Agamotto became crucial to Infinity War and Endgame
- **Benedict Cumberbatch as Strange** — Became one of the MCU''s most important characters
- **The Dormammu Bargain** — "I''ve come to bargain" became one of the MCU''s most iconic scenes
- **Multiverse Setup** — The concept of alternate dimensions set up the entire Multiverse Saga

## Fun Facts

- The city-folding sequence was inspired by M.C. Escher''s impossible architecture
- Benedict Cumberbatch wore the Cloak of Levitation on set — it was a real practical prop
- The film''s visual effects team created over 1,400 VFX shots
- Mads Mikkelsen spent 3 hours daily in makeup for his Kaecilius look
- The Dormammu time loop scene was originally much longer in early cuts

## Viewing Context

Doctor Strange is the **fourteenth MCU film** and the second entry in Phase 3. It''s largely standalone but introduces the Time Stone and the concept of the multiverse. Strange becomes a key player in Infinity War and Endgame.',
  metaDescription = 'Doctor Strange (2016) MCU guide — 89% RT, $678M box office, Time Stone introduction, and trading card market analysis for Marvel collectors.',
  keywords = 'Doctor Strange, MCU Phase 3, Benedict Cumberbatch, Time Stone, multiverse, magic, trading cards, Marvel cards, box office',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Doctor Strange cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Doctor Strange on Disney+?","answer":"Yes, Doctor Strange (2016) is available on Disney+. It introduces magic and the Time Stone to the MCU."},{"question":"How much did Doctor Strange make?","answer":"Doctor Strange grossed $678 million worldwide against a $165 million budget, earning $85 million opening weekend."},{"question":"Is Doctor Strange important to the MCU?","answer":"Very — it introduces magic, the Time Stone (crucial to Infinity War/Endgame), and the multiverse concept that drives the MCU''s current saga. Strange becomes one of the most important characters in the franchise."},{"question":"What Doctor Strange cards are valuable?","answer":"Benedict Cumberbatch debut autos ($3,500+) lead the market. Mads Mikkelsen autos ($600+) and Time Stone insert cards are also sought after."},{"question":"What is the Eye of Agamotto?","answer":"The Eye of Agamotto is a mystical artifact that houses the Time Stone, one of six Infinity Stones. Doctor Strange uses it to manipulate time, most famously in his bargain with Dormammu."}]',
  status = 'published',
  updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE slug = 'doctor-strange-2016'
